context: Add node_modules to the codespell --skip list in the Makefile spellcheck target (and consider results-explorer/dist and other generated JS output). Prefer making codespell ignore-file aware, or driving the skip list from .gitignore, over hand-maintaining a parallel exclusion list that will drift again. Do NOT weaken --ignore-words.
description: Supersedes spellcheck-node-modules-skip-never-landed (dropped only to attach a work breakdown; same finding). spellcheck-scans-gitignored-node-modules is marked done, but the fix is not in the tree and that item's own verification rung ('make spellcheck exits 0 with node_modules present') fails. Makefile:942 passes a --skip list with no node_modules and no results-explorer entry, and codespell does not honour .gitignore. Reproduced on develop @ 74aee99: creating results-explorer/node_modules/pkg/index.js containing 'recieve teh occured' makes make spellcheck report three hits and exit non-zero (Error 65). Impact: make pr-preflight is red for every developer who has installed the results-explorer npm deps, which trains people to ignore a real gate. Either the fix was reverted or the item was completed without it landing.

Not reproducible in pool worktrees because @~/ is a main-clone-only stray directory, which is why CI and worktree runs stay green and only the primary clone is red.
deferrals.resolved_reason: Not dropped - TRACKED at spellcheck-scans-gitignored-at-tilde-dir (created 2026-07-30 with the full deferral content: description, approach, scope, 2 preserves, 2 work units, 2 verification rungs).
